#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int s,n,e=0,o=0;if(scanf("%d %d",&s,&n)!=2)return 1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){s=(s*17+11)%97;if(s%2)e++;else o++;}printf("state=%d even=%d odd=%d\n",s,e,o);return 0;}

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int n,a[10],size=0,x;char cmd;if(scanf("%d",&n)!=1)return 1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(scanf(" %c",&cmd)!=1)return 1;if(cmd=='+'){if(scanf("%d",&x)!=1)return 1;a[size++]=x;}else size--;}printf("size=%d top=%d\n",size,size?a[size-1]:-1);return 0;}

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int n,a[10],size=0,x,rejected=0;char cmd;if(scanf("%d",&n)!=1)return 1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(scanf(" %c",&cmd)!=1)return 1;if(cmd=='+'){if(scanf("%d",&x)!=1)return 1;if(size==10)rejected++;else a[size++]=x;}else if(size==0)rejected++;else size--;}printf("size=%d top=%d rejected=%d\n",size,size?a[size-1]:-1,rejected);return 0;}
